$meta.name: Mealdrop tokens v2
$meta.sourceOfTruth: yannbf/mealdrop @ main — code wins over Figma (Yann, 17 Jul); values verified against src/styles/theme.ts and component usage on 20 Jul 2026
$meta.structure: primitive = normalized raw scales; semantic = roles inferred from actual component usage (NOT Mealdrop's per-component key names). Components consume semantic only.
$meta.units: type in rem, space in rem (normalized from Mealdrop's em — see principles.md Departures), radius in px
rules: Semantic dark values are ALWAYS defined in full — never derived or spread from light (Mealdrop's own dark theme has inheritance bugs; see principles.md)
replaces[] lists the Mealdrop theme keys a role absorbs, for traceability

neutral.$note: Mealdrop's grey ramp + white/black/otherBlack, deduped (#202020 appeared as black AND grey.dark6; #2C2C2C as otherBlack AND grey.dark5). 200/300 have no consumers today — kept as headroom.

green.$note: The 'go / good news' accent. A SURFACE color (~1.1:1 vs white) — carries dark text, never is text or border. Ramp pruned from 11 steps to the 3 with jobs.

blue.$note: The 'calm info + focus' accent. 100/200 are surfaces; 400/700 are the only accent values ever used as ink (focus ring, review text). Ramp pruned from 11 steps to 4.

red.$note: Error only — red has exactly one job in Mealdrop. 300 promoted from Mealdrop's defined-but-unused red.light1 to fix dark-mode error contrast (departure).

brand.$note: The teal of the logo + spinner — Mealdrop's real identity color, hardcoded in Logo.tsx/Spinner.tsx and absent from its theme. Promoted into the palette per departure 3, ramp completed per the Notion brand guidelines (21 Jul): brand moments only (logo, loading, celebration), never UI chrome. In dark mode the mascot shifts to the lime ramp.

dark.$note: Mascot fills in dark mode (Logo.tsx colors.dark)

family.$note: Ignore Mealdrop's theme.fonts.family ('NunitoSans') — it is dead code. These are the fonts actually rendered (Google Fonts).
family.heading: 'Montserrat', sans-serif

size.$note: A 1.25 modular scale anchored on body 1.125rem (18px) — Mealdrop's rounded values kept verbatim. 'sm' (1rem) is the one deliberate off-scale step: small body text. px at 16px root.

tracking.$note: Display sizes (2xl/3xl) tighten; everything else default.

space.$note: Fibonacci-ish ladder in rem (px at 16px root). Two normalizations vs theme.ts: em → rem, and the 20px 'm' step (4 uses) replaced by 24px — the rhythm the components actually voted for (1.5rem is the most-used raw pad in the codebase, 12+ sites). See Departures.

radius.$note: A 4-rung ladder by floatiness, not size (see principles.md rule 11). Mealdrop's 24px and 40px steps had zero consumers and are dropped.

shadow.$note: Three shadows exist in the whole app. 'overlay' promoted from a raw value repeated 4× in Modal/Sidebar. Mealdrop's boxShadow.inner had zero consumers and is dropped.

motion.$note: Normalized from ad-hoc literals (100–500ms range). Theme cross-fade at 250ms ease-in on background/color/border is a deliberate site-wide feature — keep it.

breakpoint.$note: min-width, mobile-first. Mealdrop's XS (400px) had no consumers and is dropped. Root font drops 16→14px below 640px.

color.$note: Roles, not component names. light/dark both explicit. Values reference primitive paths.

surface.highlight.note: good-news surface; in dark mode green leaves surfaces and moves to action.primary

text.secondary.note: dark value is a departure — Mealdrop forgets to override it (2.3:1 on dark)

text.error.note: dark value is a departure — Mealdrop inherits light red at 2.3:1 on dark

action.primary.note: ink in light, branded green in dark — a role re-decision, not a tone-map (principles.md rule 5)

action.subtleHover.note: ghost/clear button hover; rest state is transparent

chip.contrast.bg.note: the always-legible cart-quantity chip — theme-independent by design

typography.$note: Text styles as used. All headings are text.primary — hierarchy is size only.

button.note: body face on purpose — never the heading face (principles.md rule 4)
